about: The webhook events LetzBill sends, as its event catalogue (GET /api/v1/webhooks/event_types) lists them. The LetzBill Trigger loads the live list from your account; tools/generate-docs.mjs renders this snapshot in docs/trigger.md. Update it when LetzBill adds, renames or removes an event. The descriptions here are plain text written for these pages; the live list in the node shows LetzBill's own descriptions.
